MAX!':'!'}</strong><span>HP 최대 +${gains.hp} · MP 최대 +${gains.mp}</span><span>TP 최대 +${gains.tpCap} · TP 충전 +${gains.tp} · 공격 +${gains.atk} · 방어 +${gains.def}</span>`;   battleEl.appendChild(fx);setTimeout(()=>fx.remove(),1750)  }  function gainXp(n,playFanfare=true){   normalizeHeroProgress();   if(hero.lv>=currentLevelCap()){hero.xp=0;hero.next=0;updateHud();if(battle)battleStatus();return 0}   hero.xp+=n;   let levels=0,learned=[];   const gains={hp:0,mp:0,tp:0,tpCap:0,atk:0,def:0};   while(hero.lv<currentLevelCap()&&hero.next>0&&hero.xp>=hero.next){    hero.xp-=hero.next;    const g=levelUpCore();if(!g)break;    learned.push(...g.learned);    gains.hp+=g.hpGain;gains.mp+=g.mpGain;gains.tp+=g.tpGain;gains.tpCap+=g.tpCapGain;gains.atk+=g.atkGain;gains.def+=g.defGain;    levels++   }   if(hero.lv>=currentLevelCap()){hero.lv=currentLevelCap();hero.xp=0;hero.next=0}   updateHud();if(battle)battleStatus();   if(levels){    const msg=`LEVEL UP! LV ${hero.lv}${hero.lv>=currentLevelCap()?' MAX':''} · HP ${hero.hp}/${hero.maxHp} · MP ${hero.mp}/${hero.maxMp} · TP ${hero.tp}/${hero.maxTp}${learned.length?' · '+learned.join(' / ')+' 습득!':''}`;    if(battle)log(msg);else showDialog(msg);    showLevelStats(levels,gains);    if(playFanfare)rpgFanfare('level')   }   return levels  }    function enterZone(z){zone=z;steps=0;battle=null;const   setTimeout(()=>{    if(!battle)return;     const e=battle.enemy;    const phase=e.finalBoss?(e.phase||1):1;     /* 최종마왕도 한 턴에 실제 피해는 1회만 준다.       형태가 올라갈수록 공격력/연출은 강해지지만 연속 피해로 행동권을 빼앗지 않는다. */    let postMove='',nongaJudgment=false;    if(e.postBoss==='nonga'){     if(e.judgmentReady){      nongaJudgment=true;e.judgmentReady=false     }else{      e.nongaTurn=(e.nongaTurn||0)+1;      if(e.nongaTurn%4===0){       e.judgmentReady=true;hero.guard=false;       log('대천사논개가 날개를 펼쳤다! <천상심판> 준비 — 다음 공격을 방어하자!');       battleStatus();updateHud();beep(880,.10,.035,'triangle',1320);buzz([20,8,34,8,48]);       setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)battle.busy=false},360);return      }     }    }    let dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(e.atk-totalDef()*.55+Math.random()*4)); lse if(e.finalBoss&&phase===2){     log(`폭주 흑우왕의 중압 강타! ${dmg} 피해!`);     buzz([18,7,30])    }else if(e.finalBoss&&phase===3){     log(`악령 흑우혼의 영혼 침식! ${dmg} 피해!`);     bombBuzz()    }else{     log(`${e.name}의 공격! ${dmg} 피해!`)    }     if(hero.hp<=0){loseBattle();return}    setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)battle.busy=false},320)   },680)  }  function act(kind,id){   if(!battle||battle.busy)return;   closeSub();battle.busy=true;   let dmg=0,text='',fx='none';    if(kind==='attack'){    const criticalChance=Math.min(.13,.075+hero.lv*.006);    const critical=Math.random()<criticalChance;    if(critical){     dmg=phys(2.6)+hero.lv*2;     hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+18,0,hero.maxTp);     text=`회심의 일격!! ${dmg} 피해!`;fx='critical'    }else{     dmg=phys(1);hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+10,0,hero.maxTp);     text=`공격! ${dmg} 피해!`;fx='slash'    }   }else if(kind==='guard'){    hero.guard=true;hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+8,0,hero.maxTp);log('방어 자세를 취했다.');battleStatus();buzz(8);return enemyTurn()   }else if(kind==='spell'){    const sp=spells().find(x=>x.id===id);    if(!sp||hero.mp<sp.mp){battle.busy=false;return}    hero.mp-=sp.mp;    if(id==='heal'){const h=12+hero.lv*2;hero.hp=Math.min(hero.maxHp,hero.hp+h);text=`회복! HP ${h} 회복.`;fx='heal'}    else if(id==='greaterHeal'){const h=28+hero.lv*3;hero.hp=Math.min(hero.maxHp,hero.hp+h);text=`대회복! HP ${h} 회복.`;fx='greaterHeal'}    else if(id==='barrier'){battle.barrier=true;text='방어막! 다음 공격의 피해를 크게 줄인다.';fx='barrier'}    else{dmg=spellDmg(id);text=`${sp.name}!${battle.enemy.weak===id?' 약점을 찔렀다!':''}`;fx=id}   }else if(kind==='special'){    const sp=specials().find(x=>x.id===id);    if(!sp||hero.tp<sp.tp){battle.busy=false;return}    hero.tp-=sp.tp;updateHud();    runSpecialCombo(id);return   }else if(kind==='item'){    if(id==='포션'&&(run.inventory.포션||0)>0){run.inventory.포션--;const before=hero.hp;hero.hp=hero.maxHp;const healed=Math.max(0,hero.hp-before);text=`포션!
